lines.en: I lift my long legs high in the water.
I test the shallows step by step.
My neck bends into a question mark.
My toes spread to grip the mud.
I wade slowly among the reeds.
My white feathers are bright in the sun.

lines.zh: 我走一步，水面就皱一下
lines.en: Each step wrinkles the water.
I work my way up the bend.
Reeds brush my chest.

lines.zh: 我不急，水里有的是时间
lines.en: No hurry; the water has plenty of time.
My reflection wavers.
The plumes on my crown stand up.
I stand on one leg, the other tucked.
I wait in the water, motionless.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸一缩，像在打拍子
lines.en: My neck extends and retracts, keeping time.
A shadow swims beneath the surface.
I stand a long while; my legs do not tire.
The tropical damp is pleasant.
I turn and preen a shoulder feather.
A fish jumps far off.
I watch the water more than the sky.
My crown plumes stir in the wind.

lines.zh: 泥滩上有别的鸟的脚印
lines.en: Other birds' prints mark the mud.
My crest feathers are pale yellow.
There is no need to hurry.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，停在空中
lines.en: I lift a foot and hold it in the air.
I tilt my head and fix one eye on you.
You stand on the bank, too dry.
My legs are taller than yours.
Your splashing is very loud.
I do not fear people; I simply dislike them.
That is no fish in your hand.
You cast your shadow on the water.
I tilt my head as if judging.
Standing that close, the mud will give.

lines.zh: 我的白羽让你的眼睛不舒服
lines.en: My white feathers bother your eyes.
Do you mean to catch me?
When I move, the water answers.
Half a stream lies between us.
Let me look at you again.
Your boots are soaked through.
I raise my head and straighten my neck.
You step forward; I step back.
I spread my wings and spring away.
A few feathers are disarranged.
I lurch and steady myself.
That made me call out.
Half a step back and the water sounds.
I flap twice.
I resent being disturbed.
I can still stand.
You startled me.
That is a fish.
Drop it in the water; I will take it.
I do not eat dead fish.
It is still moving. Good.
I approach slowly, neck extended.
One snap, then two shakes.
This one is not large.
Just back away three steps.
I will not go for your hand.
My legs are thin; I cannot hold.
I retreat, wings half open.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在水面上，你踩了。
lines.en: My shadow fell on the water and you stepped on it.
Our collision rattles the reeds.
I lift a leg to let you pass.
Steady; the mud is slick.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我掉了两根羽
lines.en: That knocked two feathers loose.
I take up another spot.

lines.zh: 我看见她的时候会站直
lines.en: When I see her, I stand taller.
We spread our wings together.
The deep reeds are better hidden.
I do not fight; I display.
I raise the plumes of my crown.
The water is quiet; the bank is loud.
We share one shallow.
Two reflections in the water.
I do not call; the gesture suffices.
She will fly first; I wait.
I take it in my long bill.
This is not food; I drop it.
Too slick; my bill cannot hold it.
I flick it onto the bank.
There is much in this mud.
I lower my head and study it.
Not mine; I leave it.
I push it into the water.
When the shadow moves, I move.
I was only passing by.
That shadow in the water is mine.
I do not watch you; I watch the surface.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，准备慢走
lines.en: I lift a leg, ready to step slowly.
If that is a fish, I go.
My bill is no weapon.
But I will hold this shallow.
You have muddied the water.
I wait for the water to settle.
You scared off my fish.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，让自己看着更大
lines.en: I spread my wings to look larger.
This is my feeding ground.
Step back and I hold.
I know you cannot see beneath.
I lower my head.
I will call once first.
Every move you make sounds in the water.
I follow along the mudflat.
Your shadow is long in the water.

lines.zh: 我不用靠近，我只需要等
lines.en: I need not come closer; I only wait.
Your footprints have not filled in.
I look up, then down.
The reeds are taller than you.
The faster you walk, the deeper you sink.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只是不喜欢
lines.en: I am not afraid; I simply dislike it.
I fold my wings in.
I am upwind of you.
You have a small dry patch left.
The water has begun to rise.
Retreat further and you are in the reeds.
I know where the exit is.
I stab with my bill.
A wing beats across your face.
That was over a fish.
I kick down from above.
One kick, and mud sprays up.
Do not put your hand in the water.
I strike once and move off.
My neck shoots out like a spear.
That stab went wide.
If you grab me, I will struggle.
Wings open, I look larger.
I retreat to the reed line.
That one did not harm you.
I lift a leg again.
The splash covers your eyes.
This kind of scuffle is tiresome.
I step out of the reeds.
The water has just fallen; the shallows show.
This bend is very quiet.
First I check the depth.
Droplets still hang on my feathers.
The sun is low; the water shines.
I raise a leg and stand.
Fish scent for a mile around.
The wind presses the reeds down.
A line of old prints in the mud.
I give one short call.
I have found my footing.
Nobody bothers this spot.
I stretch my neck and scan the distance.
The weather is good.
I stand at the water and blink slowly.
Even at dusk my white feathers show.

lines.zh: 火苗靠近，我的羽毛竖起
lines.en: Fire nears and my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，腿先着地
lines.en: I fall from height, legs first.
Water closes over my chest.
The blast throws me onto the mudflat.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我没有力气抬腿
lines.en: Too long without food to lift a leg.

lines.zh: 雷打在水中，我全身一抖
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I shudder.
There are no shallows here.
